<translate>
<!--T:9-->
'''Heat Dome Attack''' is Trunks' signature wave. Before the beam hits, it launches the closest enemy in front of you into the air, leaving them exposed to the blast.
</translate>

<translate>
== Learning it == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
[[Special:MyLanguage/Trunks|Trunks]] teaches Heat Dome Attack for '''6,000 TP'''. He has no alignment requirement. Like every ki technique, it needs [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]], an empty main hand and at least 5% Power Release, and it must be equipped in a technique slot.
</translate>

<translate>
== How it works == <!--T:12-->

<!--T:13-->
Heat Dome Attack is a '''Wave''' ki attack: hold the slot key to charge it (2.5 seconds to reach 100%), keep holding to overcharge up to 175%, and release to fire.

<!--T:14-->
When it fires, the closest enemy in front of you within '''8 blocks''' is launched into the air before the beam hits. Its damage is your Ki Damage × 2.25 × the charge.

<!--T:15-->
As a Wave attack, it can [[Special:MyLanguage/Beam Clash|clash]] with other beams.
</translate>

<translate>
== Upgrades == <!--T:16-->

<!--T:17-->
As a Wave attack, it gains experience when it hits and can upgrade its damage, speed, armor penetration and cooldown. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Techniques|Techniques]].
</translate>
